selection: largest scalar-area and first interaction pair at each level for each candidate's own tree, matching the prior diagnostic rule
screen: clean block-only Gaussian sketches matching the fixed schedule, excluding peeling contamination; all three construction seeds. Each candidate is checked to use its maximum sketch width whose predicted combined construction columns remain strictly below n_cols=11040.
candidate_rationale: The prior full runs favor added oversampling over a rank-heavy split for component error (37,20 beat 51,6), while the m=512 screen deteriorated below p=10. Preserve roughly 30% of each smaller maximum width for oversampling: (m,k,p)=(8,17,6), (16,23,10), (128,37,16). These are predeclared screening choices, not changed acceptance thresholds.

promotion.reason: Require a material (at least twofold) reduction of worst representative component error without worsening worst full-block error; rank candidates by component error. Incumbent full validation misses component by 5.1x and input by 16.3x. This is a screening rule, not an acceptance threshold or proof of infeasibility.
